case_slides.name: Fleet readiness analytics
case_slides.one_liner: Readiness picture, failure forecasts and an exception watchdog on the AI Lakehouse.

problem.intro: Logistics and maintenance commands track fleet readiness across maintenance, supply and mission systems that were never joined up.
bullets: Slow readiness picture:
the state of the fleet is assembled by hand, command by command
Late exceptions:
maintenance due dates and spares shortfalls surface after the fact
No failure forecast:
spares demand is planned from past usage, not predicted failures

solution.headline: SEE THE FLEET, CATCH THE EXCEPTIONS
solution.text: SoftServe's operations control tower, rebuilt on the AI Lakehouse: fleet, maintenance and mission data land in a gold layer that forecasts failures and spares demand. The duty officer reads readiness on one screen, asks the mart in plain language, and a watchdog agent routes each exception with a proposed fix.

case_slides.proof: Proof: FreeTech C4 Operations control tower, delivered — fleet readiness, missions and resources on one platform · Demand: USAF PANDA/CBM+ system of record; UK DAIC spare-parts and Typhoon maintenance cases; DIANA logistics

case_slides.name: Route & crew planning
case_slides.one_liner: Convoy routing and crew scheduling with NVIDIA cuOpt on OCI: the dispatcher approves the plan.

problem.intro: Movement control and maintenance units plan convoys, resupply runs and crew rosters by hand, against time windows, vehicle capacities and avoid-zones.
bullets: Slow replanning:
a changed route or a lost vehicle means rebuilding the plan by hand
Risk left to memory:
avoid-zones and convoy spacing sit with the planner, not in the plan
No baseline:
km, fuel and coverage go unmeasured, so no improvement can be shown

solution.headline: APPROVE THE ROUTE, NOT DRAW IT
solution.text: The Bosch dispatcher loop, transposed: cuOpt takes stops, time windows, vehicle capacities, avoid-zones and convoy spacing, and returns routes, crew schedules and allocations in minutes. The movement planner reviews the plan on a map, re-optimises, and writes the approved version back to the tasking system.

diagram.oci_header: ORACLE CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE · DEDICATED AI CLUSTER

case_slides.proof: Proof: Bosch workforce scheduling on cuOpt, delivered on Oracle — 2 days → 30 minutes per plan; two shipping cuOpt packs · Demand: UK DAIC last-mile resupply; DIANA 2027 responsive logistics

case_slides.name: Surveillance footage search
case_slides.one_liner: Natural-language search over drone, FMV and CCTV archives with NVIDIA VSS on OCI.

problem.intro: ISR units and base security hold hours of drone, FMV and CCTV footage that can only be found by an analyst watching it.
bullets: Review by scrubbing:
finding one event means watching the archive at speed, hour by hour
Recall is unknown:
nobody can say what share of the events in an archive was found
Footage cannot leave:
classification keeps real FMV in the estate, so tools go untested

solution.headline: ASK THE ARCHIVE, DO NOT WATCH IT
solution.text: The VSS search Channel 4 and Belron run on media archives, pointed at drone, FMV and CCTV: the pack indexes the footage with its audio track and answers plain-language questions with timestamped event summaries. The analyst opens the clip behind each hit and annotates it; the annotations feed the next tuning round.

diagram.oci_header: ORACLE CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE · DEDICATED AI CLUSTER

case_slides.proof: Proof: Channel 4 and Belron on the same VSS pack, contracted; FreeTech C6 EdgeInsight, delivered, as adjacent defence-vision proof · Demand: DIANA 2027 ISR sensing; UK DAIC AI at the Edge; Uranos KI (DE, €136M)

case_slides.name: Contract & record extraction
case_slides.one_liner: Tenders, contracts and movement records into validated fields in the system of record, on OCI.

problem.intro: Procurement agencies and MoD commercial teams retype tenders, contracts, maintenance records and movement documents into the systems that hold them.
bullets: Days per document:
a contract takes days to read, key and check before it can be used
Errors reach the record:
typed fields land in procurement and asset systems unchecked
Volume, not headcount:
NCIA alone runs a €1.4bn tender pipeline on Oracle EBS and Fusion

solution.headline: REVIEW THE FIELDS, NOT THE FILE
solution.text: The Riyadh Air extraction line, pointed at tenders, contracts and maintenance and movement records: the pack classifies each page, extracts the fields for that type with citations, and validates them deterministically. A reviewer clears the exceptions in a queue, and approved fields land in the system of record.

diagram.oci_header: ORACLE CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE · DEDICATED AI CLUSTER

engine.sub: Nemotron Parse / Nano Omni document models

case_slides.proof: Proof: Riyadh Air on the same pack, delivered on Oracle — 3–5 days → 15 minutes per contract, 90–95% dry-run accuracy · Demand: NCIA runs procurement on Oracle EBS and Fusion; US Task Force Lima enterprise bucket

case_slides.name: Doctrine & manual search
case_slides.one_liner: Cited, role-scoped answers from STANAGs, doctrine and S1000D manuals with NVIDIA NeMo on OCI.

problem.intro: Staff, trainers and maintainers look up answers in STANAGs, national doctrine and S1000D manuals that run to thousands of pages in several languages.
bullets: Answers take a search:
the right clause sits in a corpus nobody reads end to end
Not everyone sees all:
one corpus, many clearances — retrieval has to respect the role
Multilingual by default:
the same corpus has to answer in the language the reader works in

solution.headline: ANSWER WITH THE CLAUSE, NOT A GUESS
solution.text: The Knowledge Chat Agent pack indexes STANAGs, national doctrine and sample S1000D manuals next to one customer corpus — the same job as Nesma's engineering archive. A staff officer asks in their own language, gets the answer with its clause cited, and sees only what their role is cleared to see.

diagram.out: cited answers, scoped to the role
diagram.oci_header: ORACLE CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE · DEDICATED AI CLUSTER

case_slides.proof: Proof: Nesma technical-corpus search, pending; the NHS and KPN permission-and-observability harness · Demand: NATO ACT's AI FELIX read board; UK DAIC document discovery and LLMs for Defence; GenAI.mil, 3M seats

case_slides.name: Open-source intelligence briefing
case_slides.one_liner: Cited INTSUM-style briefs and entity dossiers from open sources, with NVIDIA AI-Q on OCI.

problem.intro: Intelligence and policy staffs build the daily brief by hand, reading news, official releases and open ship and flight feeds one source at a time.
bullets: The brief eats the day:
collection and formatting take the hours meant for analysis
Claims lose their source:
by the time a line reaches the brief, its origin is no longer at hand
No way to check quality:
there is no fixed question set to measure the brief against

solution.headline: EVERY LINE CARRIES ITS SOURCE
solution.text: SoftServe's Foresight analytics engine, rebuilt on NeMo + AI-Q: the agent fuses news, official releases, ship and flight feeds and one customer corpus into cited dossiers and a scheduled INTSUM-style brief. The analyst edits or approves each item against its sources; an eval harness scores a fixed question set.

source.name: Open sources + one corpus
source.sub: news, releases, ship and flight feeds
